gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed HGG (WHO grade III or IV, including GBM, astrocytoma, gliosarcoma, H3K27M mutant diffuse midline glioma).

candidate_evidence.quote: The objective of this study is to assess the tolerability, safety, and efficacy of Liposomal Curcumin (LC) in combination with radiotherapy (RT) and Temozolomide (TMZ) in patients with newly diagnosed High-Grade Gliomas (HGG).
All patients will be treated with open-label intravenous (IV) LC on a weekly basis for a minimum of 34 infusions

candidate_flag.reason: Curcumin is named in the manual as an example of an excluded supplement, but here it is an IV liposomal investigational drug product (LipoCurc) given at escalating doses; candidate status needs adjudication.

coder_notes: Mixed high-grade glioma population (WHO grade III or IV, incl. GBM, gliosarcoma, H3K27M DMG); IDH-mutant patients explicitly allowed and Roman-numeral WHO grading used, so cns5_terminology coded historical. MGMT, IDH and H3K27M appear in eligibility only as 'eligible either way' / histology examples, not as entry requirements or other biomarker roles, so no biomarker rows. Antiemetics (ondansetron, prochlorperazine) and stool softener are given only as examples ('eg', 'PRN') with TMZ and are not listed. Radiotherapy is part of the backbone.
